supporting_observations.claim: At 13:49:54 UTC, WS-ARUIZ-01 sent 50,000,371 bytes to the internal web proxy at 10.51.20.30:8080 over a connection lasting about 10 seconds; the proxy sent 8,980 bytes back.
The large transfer record is timestamped about three minutes after the alert's approximate 13:46 time; the records at 13:46:46 show Kerberos traffic to DC-PIN-01, not a large transfer.
The observed large connection is to the internal proxy, and this record alone does not show the ultimate destination or establish that the bytes reached an external service.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available connection record does not include the proxy request URL, destination host, HTTP method, or proxy disposition.
The available records do not attribute the large connection to a process or identify the files or content transferred.
The logs show a large client-to-proxy byte count, but do not by themselves establish what the proxy forwarded beyond the network.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer was an upload, what data it contained, or whether it was authorized.
The ultimate destination or service involved in the transfer.
Whether the transfer was malicious or benign.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-PIN-01 access/request logs for the connection at 13:49:54 UTC, including URL or destination, method, status, and forwarded byte counts.
Correlate the connection with endpoint process/network telemetry and file-access or upload activity on WS-ARUIZ-01.
Identify the transferred content, if retained, and verify with the user or business owner whether the transfer was expected.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox Update ran as SYSTEM on WS-ARUIZ-01 at 13:20:46; Dropbox is not listed as approved software. Review separately; the available records do not link this process to the alerted large connection. (T069-00006, T069-00007)

WS-ARUIZ-01 connected to FILE-PIN-01 over SMB at 13:42:30, and FILE-PIN-01 logged an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. Review separately; this does not establish a link to the alerted transfer. (T069-00136, T069-00139, T069-00140)
